name: AJ Bell
stock_commission_text: £5.00 per online share deal (£3.50 if you made 10+ share deals in the previous month); regular investing is free
withdrawal_text: Free to a linked UK bank account

name: AvaTrade
stock_commission_text: No commission; cost is in the spread (from 0.9 pips on EUR/USD)
withdrawal_text: Free
inactivity_text: USD 50 a quarter (EUR 50 / GBP 50, by account currency) after three consecutive months of non-use, and every successive quarter, plus an annual administration fee of USD 100 / EUR 100 / GBP 100 after twelve consecutive months

name: Capital.com
stock_commission_text: No commission; cost is in the spread (from 0.6 pips on EUR/USD)
withdrawal_text: Free

name: DEGIRO
stock_commission_text: Commission plus a EUR 1 handling fee per trade: EUR 2 total on US exchanges, EUR 3 on the Irish home market, EUR 4.90 on London, Euronext, XETRA, Swiss and Nordic exchanges, EUR 6 on Australia, Frankfurt, Hong Kong, Singapore and Tokyo. ETFs EUR 3, or EUR 1 handling only for the Core Selection (the ETFs listed on Tradegate)
withdrawal_text: Free to a linked bank account
inactivity_text: None (DEGIRO publishes EUR 0 inactivity, custody, deposit and withdrawal fees)

name: eToro
stock_commission_text: $1–$2 per side on stock positions (charged on opening and on closing, varies by country of residence); ETFs 0%
withdrawal_text: $5 per withdrawal on USD accounts ($30 min); free on GBP/EUR accounts
inactivity_text: None (eToro removed the inactivity fee in 2026)

name: Fidelity
stock_commission_text: £7.50 per online share, ETF or investment trust deal (£30.00 by phone); £1.50 for regular savings plan trades and dividend reinvestment; funds free
withdrawal_text: Free to a linked UK bank account

name: Fortrade
stock_commission_text: No commission; cost is in the spread (EUR/USD ~2 pips)
withdrawal_text: Free (some payment methods may charge)
inactivity_text: USD 10 a month (charged in your account currency) after six consecutive months with no transactions — no deposits, withdrawals or trading activity, including opening a pending order

name: Freetrade
stock_commission_text: £0 commission on all UK & US stocks, ETFs and investment trusts (all plans)
withdrawal_text: Free standard withdrawals; £5 for same-day withdrawal

name: Hargreaves Lansdown
stock_commission_text: £6.95 per online share deal (£3.95 if you dealt 20+ times in the previous month); £1.95 per online fund deal; free via monthly direct debit or dividend reinvestment
withdrawal_text: Free to a linked UK bank account

name: Interactive Brokers
stock_commission_text: UK shares 0.05% of trade value, minimum £3; European shares 0.05%, minimum €3; US shares from $0.005 per share, minimum $1 (Fixed pricing)
withdrawal_text: Two free withdrawal requests per calendar month; after that GBP 7.00 by bank transfer or GBP 1.00 by BACS/GIRO (EUR 8.00 / EUR 1.00; USD 10.00 / USD 1.00)
inactivity_text: None on the standard account (the inactivity fee was removed in 2021)

name: interactive investor
stock_commission_text: £3.99 per UK share trade (£2.99 on Premium); funds £3.99 on Core, £1.49 on Plus, free on Premium
withdrawal_text: Free to a linked UK bank account (next-day GBP and EUR); £15 for a same-day GBP or EUR withdrawal

name: InvestEngine
stock_commission_text: £0 dealing commission on all ETFs (DIY portfolios); no platform fee
withdrawal_text: Free — no withdrawal fee

name: Lightyear
stock_commission_text: UK personal accounts (GIA and ISA): no execution fee on UK, US and European stocks or ETFs. EU accounts: GBP 1 per order on UK stocks, EUR 1 per order on EUR-denominated stocks, 0.1% on other European stocks, and 0.10% (min $0.10, max $1) on US stocks. ETFs are execution-fee-free on both.
withdrawal_text: Free by local bank transfer. USD wire payments are charged (up to $8.50 UK, $6.11 EU).

name: Pepperstone
stock_commission_text: Razor: raw spreads plus a fixed commission on FX and Spot Gold (XAU/USD) only — GBP 2.25 per lot per side on a GBP account, USD 3.50 on a USD account, so GBP 4.50 / USD 7 round turn, charged in full when the position opens on MT4 and MT5; cTrader is USD 6 round turn on FX. Standard: no commission on FX, indices or commodities (the cost sits in the spread), but share CFDs cost from 0.1% per side
withdrawal_text: Free, except bank wire withdrawals to an international bank account, which are charged GBP 15

name: Plus500
stock_commission_text: No commission, cost is in the spread
withdrawal_text: Free — Plus500 charges no deposit or withdrawal fees; your own bank or card issuer may charge on international transfers or unsupported-currency conversions
inactivity_text: Up to $10/month after 3 months without logging in

name: Revolut
stock_commission_text: 1 commission-free order a month on Standard (3 on Plus, 5 on Premium, 10 on Metal and Ultra); beyond the allowance 0.25% of the order amount, or 0.12% on Ultra, minimum GBP 0.01; the Stocks and Shares ISA shares the same allowance and rates
withdrawal_text: Free

name: Robinhood
stock_commission_text: $0 / £0 commission on US stocks, ETFs and options (crypto in the US only)
withdrawal_text: Free (bank/ACH); instant withdrawal 1.75% (US); account transfer out $100

name: Scalable Capital
stock_commission_text: Price depends on the venue. European Investor Exchange (EIX) — FREE Broker: €0.99 per trade, or €0 on purchases of €250 or more in PRIME ETFs (Amundi, iShares, Vanguard, Xtrackers); PRIME+ Broker (€4.99/mo): €0 per trade from €250, else €0.99. gettex: €0.99 until 31 August 2026, then €1.99 flat from 1 September 2026 on both plans, with no free-trade threshold. Xetra: €1.99 flat from 1 September 2026, down from €3.99 plus 0.01% (min €1.50), with trading-venue fees waived. EIX is the cheapest route on both plans
withdrawal_text: Free to a linked bank account

name: Trade Republic
stock_commission_text: €1 flat per trade (Best Price execution); €2 per order for Direct Price routing to a chosen exchange (Xetra, NYSE, etc., since July 2026)
withdrawal_text: Free to a linked bank account

name: Trading 212
withdrawal_text: Free

name: Vanguard UK
stock_commission_text: No dealing charge on Vanguard funds and ETFs at the scheduled daily trade; £7.50 for optional live 'quote and deal' ETF trades
withdrawal_text: Free to a linked UK bank account

name: Webull
stock_commission_text: $0 on stocks, ETFs and options (regulatory fees on sells). UK: 0% commission on UK, US and Hong Kong / China-A shares and ETFs
withdrawal_text: Free (ACH); wires $25 to send; account transfer out $75

name: XTB
stock_commission_text: 0% up to €100k monthly turnover, then 0.2% (min €10)
withdrawal_text: Free above €100 (some entities charge €10 below €100)
inactivity_text: EUR 10/month, only after 365 days with no trade AND no deposit in the previous 90 days. Not charged on ISA accounts, where open positions are held, or on a zero balance.
